questions.query: I consent to participate in this demographic survey about my children
questions.text:
Research Study Consent - Child Demographics Survey

Study Title: Resource Allocation and Child Development Study

Purpose: We are conducting research to understand how parents make decisions about investing in their children's development. This survey will collect basic demographic information about you and your children.

What you will do: Answer questions about your background and your children. This should take approximately 5 minutes.

Confidentiality: Your responses will be kept confidential and used only for research purposes.

Voluntary Participation: Your participation is completely voluntary. You may stop at any time without penalty.
